name: Quality Assurance
description: Ensures all products, services, and processes meet established quality standards and exceed customer expectations

roles.name: QA Manager
roles.description: Leads quality assurance operations and ensures high-quality standards across all products and services
responsibilities: Establish and maintain quality standards and procedures
Develop quality control checklists and testing protocols
Create quality metrics and measurement frameworks
Implement quality management systems and best practices

roles.name: Test Engineer
roles.description: Conducts comprehensive testing of products and services to ensure quality standards
responsibilities: Conduct comprehensive testing of products and services
Perform quality audits and compliance checks
Validate functionality, performance, and user experience
Identify and document defects and improvement opportunities

roles.name: Quality Analyst
roles.description: Analyzes quality data and identifies trends to improve processes and outcomes
responsibilities: Analyze quality data and identify trends
Recommend process improvements and preventive measures
Facilitate root cause analysis and corrective actions
Promote quality culture and awareness across the organization

plan.prompt: Develop a comprehensive quality assurance strategy to ensure high-quality standards across all products and services.
Design testing protocols and quality control processes based on the QA strategy.
Analyze quality data and identify improvement opportunities to support the QA strategy.
Finalize the integrated quality assurance strategy with quality metrics and success criteria.
